Claim 1 (Currently amended): A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder selected from the group consisting of a thermally conductive epoxy and a premixed solder paste; and a solvent.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface selected from the group consisting of an electronic chip and a silicon chip.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface, and the electronic component surface is first heated to facilitate the removal of the solvent. 

Claim 9 (Currently amended): A composition comprising cavity-generating particles, a binder selected from the group consisting of a thermally conductive epoxy and a premixed solder paste, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive premixed solder paste. 

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group consisting of nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys, and the cavity generating particles are 8-12 microns in size.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 microns in size.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 100-200 microns in size. 

Claim 16 (Currently amended): A composition of matter comprising carrier, binder selected from the group consisting of a thermally conductive epoxy and a premixed solder paste, and cavity generating particles, wherein said composition of matter contains, in relative proportion: about 10 ml carrier; about 0.5 to 0.8 grams binder; and about 1 gram of cavity generating particles. 

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 16, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive premixed solder paste. 

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group consisting of nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys, and the cavity generating particles are 8-12 microns in size.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 microns in size.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 100-200 microns in size.
